study.question: Does a target-conditioned soft lag-one match association, separating continued matching from return after a nonmatch, provide useful information beyond the retained endpoint/switch/count model and ordinary conditional persistence?
study.hypothesis: r0030 ordered conditional persistence nearly recovers incumbent AUC and exceeds its matched unordered and joint-rate controls, but can be large merely because target matches are frequent. A signed difference R11-R01 between persistence given an older match and return given an older nonmatch subtracts a within-history comparator for outcome prevalence. On identical supported coordinates, chronological contrast should outperform both chronological persistence and the corresponding uniform-group-permutation ratio-of-expectations contrast if serial association is the useful missing representation. This is a provisional descriptive hypothesis, not a causal behavior claim.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit field-adapted activation ancestry. Local reference uses normalized softmax attention, unlike original DIN intensity-preserving unnormalized activation. Proposed deterministic per-field/action soft two-state lag association is outside this attention summary; ordinary transition statistics are not claimed novel.
Author README verifies only category/brand/action histories, without item identity. No exact DMR match-network or auxiliary-loss reproduction claimed; publisher full text unavailable.

Replace only its final eight scalar inputs: add common opportunity support and optionally subtract the return rate after an older nonmatch. Preserve complete r0027 feature prefix, the eight-column capacity, RNG calls, loss and optimizer. New experiment crosses chronological/permutation readout with persistence/contrast on the same observed support.

inherited_components: Full r0027-latest_endpoint embeddings, blind contextual history retrieval, counts, decay, support, extrema, cross-field ranks, frontier, burst counts, switch rates and latest endpoints.
r0030 newest-first timestamp grouping with fractional matches inside ties, sentinel padding, positive field/target IDs and known-action mask.

All original random initialization calls and eight deterministic zero-initialized extra classifier columns; 16-dimensional embeddings, hidden128/64, Adam lr0.001, original host BCE, three epochs, batch4096 and seed42.
study.proposed_difference: For each category/brand and pv/cart/fav/buy coordinate, p_g is the timestamp-group match fraction ordered newest first. J11=sum p_new*p_old, J01=sum p_new*(1-p_old), A=sum p_old, B=sum(1-p_old), all over valid adjacent pairs. Compute R11=J11/A and R01=J01/B. Chronological contrast is R11-R01. Uniform permutation of all timestamp groups gives E[J11]=(S^2-Q)/G, E[A]=(G-1)S/G, E[J01]=E[A]-E[J11], E[B]=(G-1)(G-S)/G. Its contrast is E[J11]/E[A]-E[J01]/E[B], a difference of ratios of expected masses, not an expectation of a random ratio. All four variants apply one common gate requiring G>=2 and A,B,E[A],E[B]>1e-9, and multiply chosen eight values by0.5. Retain the complete r0027 prefix; REPLACE r0030 final8 rather than stacking another8. All4 summaries computed in all4 variants. Do not infer order inside ties.
predictions: Primary: ordered_contrast minus ordered_persistence_common AUC>0 and ordered_contrast minus exchangeable_contrast AUC>0. A new best model additionally requires exceeding r0027-latest_endpoint AUC0.6208079251798616; do not conflate either comparison.

Factorial AUC interaction (ordered_contrast-exchangeable_contrast)-(ordered_persistence_common-exchangeable_persistence_common)>0 would suggest contrast benefits specifically from actual adjacency; a main effect alone supports representation utility only.

Common-support counts identical across all4; new inputs exactly zero with empty/missing histories or either unavailable older state. Algebraic identities hold to float32 tolerance; contrast lies[-1,1]. Nonzero contrast can occur when latest endpoint is zero.

Host reports sample/positive/negative counts and AUC/Logloss on frozen history/action/frequency/hour slices; exploratory expectation is greater utility in nontrivial histories, not a new slice-selection criterion. Diagnostic first512 cannot establish full-population effects.
falsifiers: Ordered contrast failing to beat common-support ordered persistence and exchangeable contrast weakens this implementation of serial-association representation, even if secondary Logloss improves.
Equal or larger contrast gain under permutation makes a specifically chronological explanation unsupported.

Common gate discards almost all match-supported opportunities, inputs have negligible variation, inherited feature prefix changes, finite/bounds/identity checks fail, or missing IDs introduce nonzero inputs: implementation/support explanation must precede scientific interpretation.

Single-seed gains smaller than subsequent paired-seed variation, or no incumbent improvement under reserved repetitions, prevent a robust performance claim. One negative implementation does not refute all transition models.
alternative_explanations: R0030 AUC differences are one seed after extensive adaptive validation reuse across125 trajectories; multiple selection and seed noise remain.

Contrast has a signed scale and changes feature geometry; an improvement may be easier optimization rather than additional information. Common support introduces a data-dependent selection gate, fixed across cells but different from r0030.
A large rate from scarce opportunities may overfit. Fixed common gate removes undefined states, not low-support estimation noise; shrinkage is a separate next question.
Group fractions are soft surrogate states; products do not identify within-tie transitions or causal preferences. Timestamp groups rather than events are weighted equally.

The128-event prefix and static snapshots limit coverage and point-in-time claims; hashing can collide category/brand IDs. Age ordering and observed behavior history cannot establish latent interest causality.
The retained parent already includes order/switch/endpoint summaries; this tests an explicit readout inductive bias, not availability of novel information.

The shared eligibility gate depends on observed older-state opportunities, and the retained parent contains ordered summaries. Exchangeable variants remove chronology only from the replacement rate values; they are not globally order-free models or a causal randomization test.
